Ava (CEO): Quick pulse from the exec table — high level priorities for the next 30d: 1) cut 95th pct latency on Hosted API to <120ms, 2) finalize Dedicated agreement in pipeline, 3) close Private VPC pilot with the bank and start onboarding, 4) push Optimize recommendations to reduce unit cost by ~12%. Metrics snapshot: MRR +18% QoQ, Hosted token volume +27% MoM, Dedicated commit adds ~+$450k ARR this quarter. Churn steady ~1.2%. FYI we had an embeddings incident Mon AM (~45m) — Sam's postmortem below.

Maya (VP Product): TL;DR — roadmap unchanged. Focus on reliability (tracing + evals), rollout of structured outputs v2, and two prompt-optimization features for Optimize. Will share adjusted milestones by EOD Friday.

Diego (VP Eng): Engineering priorities aligned. Diego: infra sprint starts tomorrow: kernel selection improvements, KV cache tweaks, and a small quantized runtime improvement. Hoping for measurable latency gains by next week.

Sam (Dir SRE): Incident summary (brief): embeddings pipeline experienced a regression after a config rollout. Root cause: cache invalidation edge-case on prefix caching. Impact: embeddings API returned 500s for 45m for ~3% of requests. Mitigation: rollback + hotfix. Follow-ups: add a unit test for cache invalidation, increase canary duration, and add alerting for error-rate spikes above 0.5% for 5m. Postmortem draft in #incidents — please review.

Lina (Head of Finance): Finance note — Q3 bookings looking strong, slight timing shift on a large Dedicated contract (should close next week). Cash runway unchanged. Recommend we hold on expanding spend until after Dedicated commit finalizes.

Ava (CEO): A few asks: 1) Diego/Maya — one-pager on latency plan + risk by Wed, 2) Sam — postmortem + checklist in incidents by tomorrow noon, 3) Lina — update forecast after contract close. Also please flag any blockers to hiring in Eng/Product; we may re-prioritize open headcount.

Diego (VP Eng): Noted. Working on the one-pager — will include perf targets, rollout plan, and rollback criteria.

Maya (VP Product): Will add product acceptance criteria and eval datasets.

Sam (Dir SRE): Postmortem link posted: <https://redwood.internal/incidents/embeddings-1749054280>. Action owners assigned.

deploy-bot: canary rollout started: model-variant/llama-quant-v2 -> 10% traffic in us-west. Triggered by: Diego.

Diego (VP Eng): FYI monitoring looks stable on canary after 30m. No error spike. Will move to 25% after checks.

Ava (CEO): Great. Quick wins are important here — if anyone needs exec support (customer escalation, legal/compliance assist for Private pilot), ping me directly. Thanks all — short sync next Monday same time. :rocket:
